Choices:
A. [MARKED CORRECT] a sonné
B. avait sonné
C. sonnait
D. allait sonner

responses.raw:
VERDICT: TRUE
REASON: The construction "à peine... quand" (barely... when) requires the passé composé for the interrupting action, making "a sonné" the correct choice while "avait sonné" would create an illogical temporal sequence.
